patient_synopsis.authored_text: Dan Cohen (1989-03-15) is a 37-year-old man with premature CAD c/b anterior STEMI s/p mid-LAD DES (04/2024), post-MI LVEF 54%, GAD with cardiac-focused anxiety, ADHD, and childhood asthma. [[patient_source|8d83f961-085b-4210-a692-852d560f7969|37560702-a612-4fb2-9828-f5afe843bcc5]] At the latest cardiology review on June 18, 2024, he reported complete medication adherence and no angina or HF symptoms; the regimen was aspirin 81 mg daily indefinitely, ticagrelor 90 mg twice daily through at least April 2025, and atorvastatin 80 mg nightly. [[patient_source|3f167c3a-6059-455a-b646-4230297874f7|d44e5aff-49aa-4931-9d7c-79e782f84918]] Brief nonprogressive resting dyspnea was attributed to ticagrelor, which he preferred to continue; asthma was quiescent. [[patient_source|3f167c3a-6059-455a-b646-4230297874f7|d44e5aff-49aa-4931-9d7c-79e782f84918]] Anxiety with pulse checking and exertion avoidance was the main recovery limitation, with sertraline 50 mg daily, therapy, and a graded walking plan documented. [[patient_source|3f167c3a-6059-455a-b646-4230297874f7|d44e5aff-49aa-4931-9d7c-79e782f84918]] [[patient_source|a4638471-ed07-4d92-bad2-8bf5cd085105|e09f5656-c150-463f-b3e8-c564c88258e5]] Atomoxetine 40 mg daily was continued for ADHD with BP/HR monitoring. [[patient_source|a4638471-ed07-4d92-bad2-8bf5cd085105|e09f5656-c150-463f-b3e8-c564c88258e5]] Unresolved items are the current antiplatelet and statin regimen, bleeding or recurrent symptoms, planned lipid/hepatic and lipoprotein(a) results, repeat echocardiography, and subsequent cardiology and psychiatric follow-up, including walking progression and atomoxetine monitoring; the 2024 plan does not establish ticagrelor use beyond April 2025. [[patient_source|3f167c3a-6059-455a-b646-4230297874f7|d44e5aff-49aa-4931-9d7c-79e782f84918]] [[patient_source|a4638471-ed07-4d92-bad2-8bf5cd085105|e09f5656-c150-463f-b3e8-c564c88258e5]]
